verses.text: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix halan t'ayin icha tik:
Ha in Jehová in swal icha tik: Te aykot yowal in k'ol yuj tas tz'utaj Sion.

Ol in meltzaj t'a Jerusalén yik tzin kajnajxi ta'. Ichato chi' a Jerusalén chi', Chonhab' k'anab'ajum ol sb'iejxikani. Haxo in tzalan a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, ol skuch tzalan Yiknhej Jehová.
Ha heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' heb' ix chichimtak ix, ol emxok k'ojan heb' b'ajtak smolb'ej sb'a anima t'a Jerusalén. k'okochte'xonhej ol ek' heb' yuj icham animail.
Haxo b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima chi', ol b'ut'jok yuj heb' unin stajni ta'.
Ha heb' anima aykan t'a yol in chonhab' tik, toxonhej ol sat sk'ol heb' yilan jun chi'. Palta a in tik, manh ol satlaj in k'ol wilani. Ha in ton Jehová in swal juntzanh tik.
Ha in ol in kol in chonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh nación t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ol wik'anxikot heb', ol kajnajxok heb' t'a Jerusalén tik. Ol ochxok heb' in chonhab'ok, ol in ochnhej sDiosalok heb'. Ol wak'xi yajalil t'a heb' t'a stojolal, icha ix aj walani, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex ix eyab' juntzanh lolonel ix yalel heb' in chekab' atax ix em yich sb'ojixi in templo, ak'ek eyip, munlajanhek he masanil.

Ha t'a yalanhtax juntzanh k'ual chi', malaj b'aj skot stojol heb' winh munlajwum yet' stojol nok' chej smunlaji. Yuj heb' ajk'o'ol, manh junk'olalok tzex b'eyek'i, hanhejtona' a in ix wak' eyajk'olej he b'a.
Palta haxo tiknaik, a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swala' to manhxo ol in k'ulej t'ayex a ex tzex kan t'a jun chonhab' tik, icha ix in k'ulej t'a yalanhtax chi'.

T'a junk'olal ol ex ajok, ol yak' nhab', yuj chi' a te' eyuwa, ol ste ak'ej sat te', ol yak' wal sat tas tzeyawej t'a sat he lu'um. Ha inxo ol wak' masanil juntzanh tik t'ayex a ex janak exxi t'a jun chonhab' tik.
Ex aj Judá yet' ex aj Israel, icha ix aj he b'inaj t'a skatab' juntzanhxo chonhab', icha pax chi' ol aj he b'inaj yuj heb' t'a wach'ilal, yujto a in ol ex in koleli. Manh ex xiwok, tek'b'ejek he b'a.
Ha in ton Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ix in na' wak'och sya'elal heb' he mam eyicham ayik ix stzuntzankot wowal heb'. Ha tas ix in na' chi', ix in k'ulej.
Ichapax chi' tiknaik, ix in na' to ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá. Yuj chi' manh ex xiwok.
Haton wal juntzanh tik yowalil tze k'ulej: Anhej tas yel tzeyal-laj t'ayex junjun ex. Tze ch'olb'itej yaj tas t'a stojolal, yik wach' ay junk'olal t'a he kal.
Manh eyak' chukal t'ayex junjun ex, manh eyak' he ti' t'a esal t'ayex junjun ex. Ha in Jehová in swala', wal yel malaj in gana t'a juntzanh b'eyb'al chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalanxi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'ayin icha tik:

Ex yinhtilal Judá, a tzek'ojk'olal tz'och t'a schanhil uj, t'a yo'il, t'a yukil yet' t'a slajunhil uj, ol meltzajkanoch t'a k'inhal yuj he tzalajk'olal. Yuj chi', b'eyb'alejek tojolal yet' junk'olal, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol kot anima t'a juntzanhxo niwak nación, ol jawok heb' t'a Jerusalén tik.

Ha heb' anima t'a junok nación, ol ek' yal heb' t'a heb' ay t'a junokxo icha tik: Koyek, b'at kak'ekem ko b'a t'a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yik syak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh. Koyek elanhchamel ket'ok, xcham heb'.
Yuj chi' manhxo jantakok anima t'a niwak nación te ay yip ol ja t'a Jerusalén tik, ol ul yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, yik sk'anan in wach'k'olal heb' t'a yib'anh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', lajunhwanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il tz'alan ch'ok ti'al ol och tzuktzuk t'a spichul junok aj Judá, ol yalan heb' icha tik: Sko nib'ej tzonh b'at het'ok, yujto ix kab'i to ha Dios ayoch heyet'ok, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
